svg.title: Figure23 Security Context Propagation
svg.desc: NEW-shot2play Protocol Suite Version 2.0. Security context propagation and validation across authentication, entitlement, policy evaluation, authorization, enforcement, and audit.
svg.text: Security Context Creation, Propagation, Binding, and Validation
A receiving domain SHALL validate the context required for its own security responsibility.
Expired, malformed, stale, mismatched, or integrity-invalid context SHALL NOT be accepted.
Each domain establishes the authority appropriate to its own responsibility.
Context validation failure SHALL produce controlled protocol failure; recovery SHALL preserve the original security context.
